purpose: Teach: 月別/予備校/破損/労災/ストレージ/辞職/役に立っ/明言

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広報、月別レポート、来月から、フォーマット、変えましょう。
lines.en: Let's change the format for the monthly PR report starting next month.
lines.style: Clean, businesslike opening. Decisive without curtness. Lean forward slightly into the instruction. Assume agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。子育て社員向け、予備校通いの補助、検討しています。
lines.en: Got it. We're looking into a cram-school subsidy for staff with children.
lines.style: Attentive, taking notes in real time. Affirmative without overdoing it. Quick, willing—the tone of someone who writes things down as they listen.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 設備の破損、報告は、すぐ、上に、上げてね。
lines.en: And equipment damage—report it upstairs right away, okay?
lines.style: Brisk but not unkind. Light tap of emphasis on 'right away.' Eyes forward, moving to the next item. Professional but human.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労災予防、社内安全週間、来月、開催します。
lines.en: Understood. We're running a workplace safety week next month.
lines.style: Steady, informative delivery. Not reading a list—relaying something he's already absorbed. Calm, reliable presence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: クラウドストレージ、契約、更新時期、近いわよ。
lines.en: The cloud storage contract is coming up for renewal soon.
lines.style: Practical warning, not alarmist. Slight lift at the end—flagging something that needs attention but isn't urgent yet. Keep it light.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員の辞職、社員にも、丁寧に、説明、必要です。
lines.en: Right. We should explain the executive resignation to the staff carefully.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Lands lightly on 'carefully'—that word carries the weight. Showing he's thought about how this lands.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 前回の研修、本当に、役に立ったわよ、私、評価したい。
lines.en: The last training session was really helpful—I want to make sure they know I noticed.
lines.style: Warm appreciation breaking through the routine. Slower pace on this one. Genuine pleasure that work went well. A small moment of grace in a busy meeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来期方針、社長から、明言される予定です、社員総会で。
lines.en: Understood. The president will announce the next-term direction at the all-staff meeting.
lines.style: Calm closure. Forward-looking without speculation. The even tone of someone wrapping up but ready for what comes next.
